scripts.text: [Access Controller]
scripts.translation: [通行控制员]

scripts.text: I am sorry but only permitted members can enter from this point.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，从这里开始只有获准的人员才能进入。

scripts.text: [Mechanician Mugeosi]
scripts.translation: [机械师穆戈西]

scripts.text: Ah! You're the adventurer send to deliver air cleaners. You are at the right place. Come this way.
scripts.translation: 啊！你就是来送空气净化器的冒险者。没错，地方就是这里，跟我来。

scripts.text: [Bunker Sayhu]
scripts.translation: [地堡赛虎]

scripts.text: Hey!! Where do you think you're going when we're trying to get a headcount? Get over here.
scripts.translation: 喂！！我们正在清点人数，你还想去哪儿？快过来。

scripts.text: [Bioengineer Ebrik]
scripts.translation: [生物工程师埃布里克]

scripts.text: Are you the Adventurer here to help us with the grape harvest? Right here!!
scripts.translation: 你就是来帮我们收葡萄的冒险者吗？在这里！！

scripts.text: [Bioengineer Touring]
scripts.translation: [生物工程师图灵]

scripts.text: Wait a minute. You cannot enter the farm right now.
scripts.translation: 等一下。现在不能进入农场。

scripts.text: [Transportation Executive Ernon]
scripts.translation: [运输主管埃尔农]

scripts.text: Hey~ This is a time to borrow even the hands of small children. Stop goofing around and come here.
scripts.translation: 喂~现在连小孩子的手都要借来帮忙。别磨蹭了，快过来。

scripts.text: [Nurse Lapplad]
scripts.translation: [护士拉普拉德]

scripts.text: Look here?! Where are you trying to go? We have to do some tests so don't leave and wait here!!
scripts.translation: 看这边？！你想去哪儿？我们还要做些检查，别走，在这里等着！！

scripts.text: [Nurse Lapplad]
scripts.translation: [护士拉普拉德]

scripts.text: Hello? You have to deal with it before you can go? Where do you want to go!?
scripts.translation: 喂？事情处理完之前你不能离开。你要去哪儿！？
